export_evidence: No shipment row was visible on any accessible source. ImportKey company pages exist for three slug variants (tmv-natural-oils-extracts-p-ltd, tmv-natural-oils-and-extracts-private-limited, tmv-natural-oils-extracts-pvt-ltd) but each renders only the boilerplate line "Shipments available for TMV NATURAL OILS EXTRACTS PVT LTD, refreshed daily" with a "Loading..." placeholder and no dated record, destination, HS code or bill-of-lading number. Source counter: 3 ImportKey pages opened, 0 shipment rows actually seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split was retrieved. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned "Connection refused" on every query, so no domestic-supply source could be located; nothing to quote. Source counter: 0 domestic sources opened, 0 rows seen.
note: Evidence could not be gathered, not evidence of absence. ImportKey pages resolve for the company name (so the name is indexed in Indian customs trade data), but the free view exposes zero rows — no date, destination, HS code or B/L number could be read, so export_status is unknown rather than confirmed or none_found. Volza, Eximpedia and Trademo all returned HTTP 403; ImportGenius returned a JavaScript challenge; the web_search tool was non-functional for the whole session (searx connection refused), which blocked any discovery of GST/GeM/CPPP or annual-report material. Declared HS codes 130219 / 330112 / 330119 / 330124 (vegetable saps and extracts; essential oils of citrus, other, and peppermint) are plausible for a natural oils and extracts producer but were NOT verified against any shipment record — per project rule 3, HS mismatch is not a rejection ground anyway. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in anything retrieved; not invented). No CIN, PAN or GSTIN confirmed. Recommended next step: re-run with a working search backend and a paid/free-trial ImportKey or Volza view to pull dated B/L rows before assigning any confirmed status.
